description: Checks a filled EIC, Minor Works certificate or EICR (shape from get_certificate_schema) and returns `ready_to_transfer`, every missing required field by path, errors (readings that fail: insulation resistance under 1 megohm at 500 V, measured Zs above the maximum for the breaker, RCD trip times too slow, wrong polarity, an EICR marked satisfactory with a C1 or C2) and warnings (Zs above 80% of maximum, mismatched ring readings, low insulation resistance). Contractor fields left blank are filled from `trade`. Returns the (prefilled) data back.

data.description: The certificate object, shaped like the JSON Schema from get_certificate_schema.

trade.description: Optional. The electrician's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill certificate contractor fields and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Spark Pack.

address.description: Business address for the certificate contractor block.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Bright Sparks Electrical".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme the business is registered with.

name: check_certificate
title: Check a filled certificate
